facts: Elizabeth Holmes founded Theranos at age 19 after discussing the idea with Stanford chemical engineering professor Channing Robertson.
Theranos is a private, Palo Alto-based corporation that has raised more than $400 million, valuing the company at over $9 billion.
The company operates a high-complexity laboratory certified by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS).
Theranos performs blood tests using only a few drops of blood collected via a finger stick into a tiny vial called a nanotainer.
Theranos prices its tests to never exceed half the Medicare reimbursement rate for each procedure and publishes its prices online.
Walgreens committed in September to a gradual national rollout to establish Theranos wellness centers in its drugstores.
